rpc_contract.session_selection: Mutations require the exact session selected by authenticated project or workspace continuation in the current execution. Entry and continuation invalidate prior selection; a ready exact capsule, owner-issued handoff acceptance, or authenticated campaign task binding can establish the session binding.
rpc_contract.workspace_fence: Workspace continuation resolves the protected cwd to one immediate configured Git checkout through its Git common directory and validates that checkout's one-repository Environment definition.
rpc_contract.claim_transfer_target: Both separated and equals-form --transfer-to arguments are parsed and the recipient session is checked against the authenticated Control principal.

system_monitor_capability.name: mncs-system-monitor:system-observability
system_monitor_capability.authorization: User explicitly approved this exact allowlist binding and protected allowed, wrong-session, and extra-argument tests.

validation.restart_reconciliation: The protected test drops the checkpoint response after publication, restarts Control, selects the exact session through authenticated continuation, retries the same request identity, and reads back one checkpoint.
validation.workspace_selection: The protected workspace entry test reuses its Environment session and attaches the bounded continuation capsule. Separate RPC tests prove exact repository selection, selected-session checkpoint and claim operations, and cross-session rejection.

unexpected_immutable_record.cause: A negative probe found that the prior Control revision authorized checkpoint mutation without checking the session selected by continuation.
unexpected_immutable_record.handling: Immutable checkpoint is disclosed and preserved. The unselected session was not modified again; no rollback or deletion was attempted.

limitations: The Bubblewrap integration tests use an isolated test-owned Environment Store and prove the Control authorization and restart path under confinement. They do not replace the separate canonical Store acceptance proof.
Compiler and Forge remain protected by the prior consumers' exclusive claims. No tests, merges, or worktree retirement were performed for those repositories.
